name: Natsuane
source:
Won't you return to that summer. 
To a time of boyhood, on vacation with that special one? 

I went to live with my older cousin that summer. 
We went to the nearby beach together. 

I remember she took her top off. It was my awakening. 
Bewildered I submit to her guidance. 
Me and onesan started a sexual affair that summer. 

Morning noon and night, a summer of love! 
Ecchi animations comprising a hybrid of novel game + 3DCGs
Enjoy each scene and their many situations.
